mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points, sustained for two consecutive months, signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05) or false signal rate exceeds 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) of more than 5% signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05) or false signal rate exceeds 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) of more than 0.5% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings for consumer-facing sectors and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05) or false signal rate exceeds 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings for industrial firms and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05) or false signal rate exceeds 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate of more than 0.5 percentage points signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05) or false signal rate exceeds 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) of more than 50,000 signals robust labor market growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05) or false signal rate exceeds 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) of more than 0.5% combined with a monthly increase in the federal funds rate of more than 0.25 percentage points signals both weakening demand and tighter monetary policy, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 0.5% AND FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.05) or false signal rate exceeds 50%.
